mismatch.message: dmonsfree: 1 removed does not match 0 pending

summary: The saved v54 baseline reports a runner error rather than a positional match count: dmonsfree sees one removed monster but no pending removal. In the C recording, the earth-scroll boulder hits the lichen lethally at input step 190. C read.c:drop_boulder_on_monster calls mon.c:killed when byu is true; JS reaches the same branch but calls note_unported("mon.c killed"), skipping the already implemented kill cleanup. This bounded divergence is in the by-you lethal-hit caller branch; it does not claim whole-function completion.

source.branch: When a solid monster is at (x,y), the falling boulder reduces mhp below one, and byu is true, read.c:drop_boulder_on_monster calls killed(mtmp) before waking nearby monsters and placing the boulder. killed() calls xkilled(XKILL_GIVEMSG), which performs the monster detach/death cleanup that dmonsfree later checks. JS read.js has the same damage and byu test, but substitutes note_unported("mon.c killed"), so the monster never enters the pending removal path.
callers: C read.c:seffect_earth (1963) passes TRUE as byu for each surrounding monster; js/read.js:seffect_earth passes true to drop_boulder_on_monster.
C mon.c:killed (3470-3473) forwards XKILL_GIVEMSG to xkilled; existing js/mon.js exports killed() and xkilled() and accepts the caller state and environment.
dependencies: The selected lethal branch consumes no return value from killed(). The existing mon.js killed/xkilled implementation is the required callee and is not part of this edit scope.
The separate byu=false branch calls mondied after its own message. It is not reached by the selected case and remains represented by note_unported("mon.c mondied").

evidence: Saved admitted baseline challenges/evaluations/baseline-78195d815-v54.json records this case as 0/218 screens, 0/2865 RNG calls, and error "dmonsfree: 1 removed does not match 0 pending". The combined queue identifies the exact case, v54 manifest, recording SHA-256 6ac667e947322bf8c0609df158143dbe36f8714b2a0bcadad91cc1d32bbd0fdf, canonical manifest digest cc258ba889b65b063f34199074d3313017b5d89ce3c175bb5443889ef9713e8e, and 218 recorded steps.

The admitted manifest source trace distinguishes the 189-step captured prefix and first missing screen at step 190 from the runner exception index; the first missing behavior is the lethal boulder-hit result, not an index-zero failure.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:drop_boulder_on_monster (2341-2410) subtracts damage and calls killed(mtmp) on a by-you death at 2385-2390. mon.c:killed (3470-3473) calls xkilled with XKILL_GIVEMSG; JS read.js currently omits this call despite an existing killed() implementation in js/mon.js.

The production entry is cmd.c read command -> read.c:doread -> seffects -> seffect_earth -> drop_boulder_on_monster. The source port of seffect_earth and boulder helper is retained in GOALS.json; this diagnosis requests only the missing call in the lethal by-you branch.
